defects.repro: month_end(date(9999,12,31)) raises OverflowError (date value out of range). months_between with an end in December 9999 fails the same way.
defects.fix: Compute month_end with calendar.monthrange(day.year, day.month)[1] and build the date from it. In months_between, stop the loop when the end of the month is date.max.
defects.if_skipped: Dates in December 9999 crash with an unexpected OverflowError. The effect is negligible in practice.
